items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no direct statements from the interviewee about their personal relationship with Jay McShann. The interviewer mentions Jay McShann in the context of Charlie Parker ('Jay McShann and the musicians with the famous Charlie Parker'), but the interviewee does not respond with pers

ctx.x: I think it's because of all the spooks laying around, getting ready to have a ball by themselves, you know and all the famous bands would come to -- that's when I first met Charlie Parker. was Jay McShann The band was there in Kansas City as well as our band, Harlan Leonard, there was Tommy Douglas, clarinet player. He had a group there.
